name: Gravitic Deadfall
introDiscord: Gravity presses unpredictably across the Deadfall. Shizuki's abandoned camp contains seventeen backpacks tied to one rock. This requires investigation.
introTwitch: Gravity presses unpredictably across the Deadfall. Shizuki's abandoned camp contains seventeen backpacks tied to one rock. This requires investigation.

gravitic-deadfall-approach.prompt: Three routes descend beneath shifting gravitational pressure.

left.message: A cometglass seam is compressed beneath heavy gravity.

right.message: A Gravitic Stonefish increases the weight around you simply by existing rudely.

forward.message: Shizuki's tonic is strapped beneath several backpacks. "Pack #8 floated away. We are overcorrecting."
forward.fullHpMessage: You leave the overcorrection supplies untouched.

gravitic-deadfall-depths.prompt: Gravity changes again across three routes.

left.message: A Stonefish makes your equipment suddenly feel several times heavier.

right.message: A star-chart coffer rests beneath a strangely light patch.

forward.message:
A Berry sits inside Backpack #17.

Shizuki wrote:

"Why seventeen?

Because sixteen floated away."

gravitic-deadfall-threshold.prompt: Heavywater Pit pulls everything toward its center.

left.message: Shizuki's tonic has been tied down with enough rope to restrain furniture.
left.fullHpMessage: You leave the aggressively secured bottle untouched.

right.message: A Gravitic Stonefish waits inside the heavy current.

forward.message:
"A meteor-iron reliquary lies at the edge of the pit."

BOSS:

bossPromptDiscord:
The pressure doubles.

Every loose object slams toward the center.

Something enormous shifts below.

Use /yes to enter Heavywater Pit or /no to leave while your backpack still weighs approximately one backpack.
bossPromptTwitch:
The pressure doubles.

Every loose object slams toward the center.

Something enormous shifts below.

Use !yes to enter Heavywater Pit or !no to leave while your backpack still weighs approximately one backpack.
bossRetreatText: You retreat until gravity becomes merely inconvenient.

boss.revealText:
A colossal Stonefish rises beneath crushing pressure.

Masskeeper Stonefish reveals itself!

completionText:
"The pressure fades.

Backpack #17 remains securely attached.

Shizuki would be proud."
